name: The Wounds of Betrayal

angles.text: As druidic caretakers of the wilds, seeing fellow practitioners—specifically the scarce shen'dorei druids—succumb to betrayal and grievous injury carries a heavy, personal weight.
Night elves revere the druidic traditions, making the suffering of kindred druids in Shadowgale Forest and the struggle against treachery deeply resonant.

aliases: who gives the wounds of betrayal
quest giver the wounds of betrayal
faq.answer: The quest is given by Elegael, a shen'dorei druid desperately trying to tend to her wounded brethren following a violent attack in Shadowgale Forest.
faq.q: Who gives the quest The Wounds of Betrayal?

faq.answer: Nightfang Den is a cave situated north just across the clearing in Shadowgale Forest, where injured shen'dorei druids have retreated seeking refuge.
Jorel Windsinger is the mate of Elegael. He was severely injured in the attack and remained inside Nightfang Den, where the player discovers his tragic fate.
The shen'dorei are a rare group with very few druidic practitioners among them. Because their numbers are so small, Elegael emphasizes that every single surviving life among them is precious.

aliases: why does elegael hate al aketh
faq.answer: The Al'Aketh are enemies responsible for or allied with those who attacked the druids. Upon learning of Jorel's fate and the devastation of her order, Elegael vows vengeance against the Al'Aketh and anyone allied with them.

When you locate Jorel Windsinger in the den, you discover that his condition took a tragic turn. Returning to Elegael with news of his fate and the dire state of the surviving druids drives her to grief and a furious vow of revenge.
faq.q: What happens to Jorel Windsinger in the quest?

sections.body: The Wounds of Betrayal begins with Elegael, a shen'dorei druid tending to the aftermath of a catastrophic assault in Shadowgale Forest. Having hastily prepared medicinal poultices, she urgently seeks an adventurer to deliver aid to her brethren taking shelter in the nearby Nightfang Den, just north across the clearing. The shen'dorei druids are exceedingly few in number, making the survival of every single member vital to their fragile enclave.
sections.title: Aid for the Shen'dorei

sections.body: Beyond delivering emergency care to the seven battered druids in the cave, Elegael carries a personal plea close to her heart: finding her mate, Jorel Windsinger. When she fled the fighting to prepare medicines, Jorel was already clinging to life. Venturing into the dark recesses of Nightfang Den reveals the true devastation wrought upon the sanctuary and the grim fate that befell Jorel.
sections.title: The Search for Jorel Windsinger

sections.body: Upon hearing of Jorel's tragic end and the horrific toll on her brethren, Elegael's composure shatters into grief and fury. Gritting her teeth with a pained snarl, she renounces despair in favor of outright retribution, swearing that anyone allied with the shadowy Al'Aketh will suffer her unrelenting wrath for the slaughter of her people.
sections.title: A Vow of Retribution

summary: The Wounds of Betrayal is a quest in Shadowgale Forest centering on the aftermath of a tragic assault against the rare shen'dorei druids. Players are sent by Elegael to deliver urgent poultices to her wounded brethren in Nightfang Den and search for her missing mate, Jorel Windsinger. The mission quickly exposes the bitter costs of betrayal and fuels a vengeful conflict against the Al'Aketh.
